Legs: "Morabo 6 1/4 " wood" (the page's leg choice); the add-on's own rows give no height under it, the sofa's and the sectionals' give 6 1/4". Its 30 3/4" is its width with no armrest: the sofa's removable armrest moves to its outer end, so it adds 30 3/4" to a MORABO's width (the loveseat's 65 3/8" + 30 3/4" = the Sofa with chaise's 96 1/8"; the 5-seat corner's 111" + 30 3/4" = the 6-seat crn/chaise's 141 3/4")

notes: Flags: delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22: a sofa section; 2 packages, the chaise section frame 64 1/2 x 32 1/4 x 21 1/2" at 69 lb 4 oz, and the legs). Andrew's link (2026-10-25), his example of the open base he wants under the sofa. It attaches to the end of a MORABO sofa, loveseat or corner sectional ("Removable armrests make it easy to add on a chaise lounge", on the sofa's page). The U (living-room f since 2026-10-26, when Andrew's cart chose the Sofa with chaise ikea-49318323 for a and e) is the 5-seat corner ikea-99318311 with this unit at its end, the same footprint as IKEA's 6-seat crn/chaise, which comes only in leather (ikea-09575866). Open base: "Height under furniture: 6 1/4 "" on its 6 1/4" wood legs, the open floor Andrew asked for (2026-10-25: "Sofa must have empty space bettwen like" the MORABO chaise add-on), high enough for a robot vacuum (design-review.md). Cover: Gunnared polyester. The MORABO sofa's page says its Gunnared cover is a "Stationary cover." / "Non-removable cover", care "Vacuum clean." and wipe clean (Materials and care, 2026-10-25); this piece's care section was not opened, so it is taken to be the same, vacuumed rather than washed (F-66).
